title: China commits to low-carbon electrification and help for others to improve
summary_full: Exclusive: Countries at Cop31 are being urged to commit to deriving 35% of their energy from electricity by 2035Cop31 live – latest updatesChina is pushing for rapid electrification of its economy using low-carbon energy and will help other countries do the same, a senior member of the Chinese delegation at the Cop31 UN climate summit has said.Wang Yi, a professor of energy and environment policy at the Chinese Academy of Sciences and a senior adviser to China’s government, said: “End-use electrification is a very clear direction. We can follow this direction while making the source of electricity clean. That’s the way to go forward.” Continue reading...
